log.notes_to_self: Day 1: killed all 9 available non-blotter criminals, all quick in afternoon. Strategy: use national + South + clips + forum + foreign; avoid blotter/sector entirely. Afternoon-only deaths preserve students, night workers and at-home people (55% of population); morning deaths could unnecessarily eliminate students. With two inaccessible kinds chosen uniformly among five, excluding sector leaves only TWO reachable kinds among our four sources in 60% of games. Then the suspect pool cannot fall below 100000*0.55*0.25^2=3437.5, so 9/day is permanently safe. In the other 40%, three selected kinds are reachable and eventually could reduce pool to 859, causing capture. No inaccessible kinds identified yet; first useful feedback comes after day 3. Do not impulsively add blotter: old constraints persist, and exposing a third reachable kind can be fatal. Maintain 9/day initially to reach rolling totals 9,18,27,36,45: double scoring day 4 and quadruple from day 5. Full safe 30-day schedule scores 981. Conferences are rounded to ONE significant figure: ideal pools 55000,13750,3437.5 appear approximately 60000,10000,3000. Partial cross-report constraints may give intermediate pools. Reassess if feedback suggests a dangerous third reachable kind; finishing uncaught has no separate reward, but capture halves all accumulated points.

Day 2: again killed all 9 non-blotter criminals, all quick in afternoon. Cumulative kills/points: 18/18. Continue national + South + clips + forum + foreign while avoiding blotter/sector pending feedback. Afternoon-only deaths preserve students, night workers and at-home people: 55% of population. Morning deaths would unnecessarily exclude students. National deaths provide no source evidence. A trace involving any inaccessible kind fails entirely. With sector omitted, if sector is reachable then only TWO of our four nonnational kinds are reachable, so the suspect pool cannot fall below 100000*0.55*0.25^2=3437.5. If sector is inaccessible, THREE selected kinds are reachable and full exposure could reduce the pool to 859, causing capture. For uniformly distributed inaccessible pairs these cases have probabilities 60% and 40%, respectively; the actual distribution is unspecified. We have no informative feedback yet. Next conference is after day 3. Rounded ideal pools: 55000->60000, 13750->10000, 3437.5->3000; cross-report alternatives can produce intermediate values. Constraints persist forever, so do not casually add blotter. At 9 kills/day rolling totals are 9,18,27,36,45: double scoring day 4, quadruple from day 5 onward. Full uncaught schedule scores 981. Reassess after feedback: a third reachable kind is dangerous, and capture halves all accumulated points. Finishing uncaught has no intrinsic bonus.

Day 3: killed all 9 non-blotter criminals, all quick in afternoon. Cumulative kills/points: 27/27 before any capture penalty. Continue avoiding blotter/sector until reviewing the conference after day 3, which should appear tomorrow. Afternoon-only deaths preserve students, night workers and at-home people: 55% of population. Morning deaths would unnecessarily exclude students. National deaths provide no source evidence. Traces involving either inaccessible kind fail entirely. We have used South, clips, forum and foreign, but never blotter. If sector is reachable, only TWO of those four kinds are reachable, so our current strategy cannot reduce the pool below 100000*0.55*0.25^2=3437.5. If sector is inaccessible, THREE used kinds are reachable, and sufficient exposure could reduce the pool to 859 and cause capture. Under an exchangeable prior these possibilities start at 60% and 40%, but the pair distribution is unspecified and survival updates the odds. Rounded reference pools: 55000->60000, 13750->10000, 3437.5->3000; cross-report alternatives can leave intermediate pools. Pool size does not identify which sources are reachable. Constraints persist forever: adding blotter could introduce a fatal third reachable kind, so do not casually switch exclusions. With 9 kills/day rolling totals are 9,18,27,36,45: all day-4 kills score double, and day-5 onward quadruple if maintained. Full uncaught 9/day schedule totals 981 points. Finishing uncaught gives no separate reward; capture halves accumulated points and ends play. Next action should consider the first informative pool announcement before changing sources.
